::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
India is Marvell's second-largest R&D hub globally. In July 2026, Marvell announced a $250 million investment to double its India workforce and expand Bengaluru and Hyderabad campuses. Teams work on 2nm-and-beyond process nodes.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Custom data centre ASICs, 5G baseband processors, networking switches, storage controllers, and high-speed analog IP. Hyderabad focuses on security solutions; Pune on embedded development for networking and storage.
